options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: Keep the picker inside `root`: Left and Backspace stop there rather than going to its parent. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: confine

options.description: Pick a directory rather than a file. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: directory

options.description: Which files are offered, by extension, with or without the dot. Directories are always offered, because the way to a file is through one.
options.name: extensions

options.description: Offer dotfiles from the start. Defaults to `false`; `.` shows or hides them while the picker is open.
options.name: hidden

options.description: Whether the highlight wraps from one end of the list to the other. Defaults to `true`, as `select()` does.
options.name: loop

options.description: The directory the picker starts in. Defaults to the working directory.
options.name: root

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: How many rows the list may take. Defaults to what the terminal has left.
options.name: rows

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: Checks the answer. Return a string to reject it with that message, or anything falsy to accept. Receives the answer in the form it will be returned in: an absolute path.
options.name: validate
options.type: (value: string) => string | undefined | false | Promise<string | undefined | false>

options.description: An answer to start from: a path, so the picker opens in the directory holding it with it highlighted. Dropped -- the picker opens in `root` -- when that directory turns out not to hold it any more, or, with `confine`, when it is outside `root`.
options.name: value
